source_title: FEMA Individual Assistance Program and Policy Guide
direct_observation: FEMA home-repair assistance is intended to make a damaged home safe sanitary or functional and is not intended to return it to pre-disaster condition
missing_stage: full restoration adequacy accessibility completion and return
evidence_status: official FEMA policy; rule not household outcome
next_test: match award to inspection permit contractor completion and habitability

source_title: GAO disaster assistance and disability report
unit_or_scope: FEMA Individual Assistance applicants January 2022 through December 2025
direct_observation: About 7.5 million people applied; 21 percent indicated a household disability; applicants requested staff interaction and accessibility support
missing_stage: denial appeal processing time award repair accessibility and later housing
evidence_status: official GAO report; aggregate applicant evidence
next_test: follow disability-related application route through accommodation and repair

unit_or_scope: federal disaster assistance and survivor needs

closed_stage: program coordination problem and measurement need
missing_stage: same-household delivery timing adequacy repair and housing outcome
next_test: compare one disaster across FEMA HUD SBA insurance and local milestones

unit_or_scope: US disaster assistance and disaster-prone housing markets 2015-2024
direct_observation: At least 448 billion dollars was appropriated for disaster assistance; premiums rose more in disaster-prone areas and resilience savings are difficult to quantify
closed_stage: aggregate spending and place-based affordability pressure
missing_stage: household coverage adequacy claims repair debt move and repeat exposure
next_test: link county risk insurance terms repair and staying/moving

source_title: World Bank Bimala Tamang Nepal earthquake reconstruction story
direct_observation: Bimala received a housing grant in installments rebuilt the house with her husband and jointly owned it; the story also reports training and community participation
missing_stage: ongoing affordability accessibility utility reliability structural quality and future return
evidence_status: official beneficiary story; household account not independent completion audit
next_test: match grant installments to inspection completion utilities and post-occupancy outcome

source_title: World Bank Wazira resilient Sindh reconstruction story
unit_or_scope: Wazira Bibi household Dur Muhammad Abro Dadu Sindh Pakistan
direct_observation: After the 2022 floods destroyed her home Wazira chose to rebuild on the same slope with foundations raised and strengthened beyond the stated minimum
closed_stage: household place attachment and adaptive design choice
missing_stage: construction completion utilities cost adequacy insurance debt and post-occupancy safety
next_test: follow the home from foundation through completion services and later hazard performance

source_title: World Bank Raloso resilient retrofit case
direct_observation: After Typhoon Haiyan the family rebuilt and retrofitted its home; a later typhoon found the family and 17 neighbours sheltering in the resilient house
closed_stage: named retrofit and neighbourhood protective function
missing_stage: full cost insurance utility continuity renter access and scalable affordability
evidence_status: official case story; strong outcome claim but limited household denominator
next_test: compare retrofit cost finance tenure and protection outcomes across owners renters and neighbours

source_title: World Bank Usha Devi owner-driven reconstruction choice
unit_or_scope: Usha Devi household Kedarnath Uttarakhand India
direct_observation: After the 2013 floods Usha chose owner-driven reconstruction and expressed renewed hope while still struggling in difficult terrain
missing_stage: repair completion utilities habitability affordability return and social continuity
evidence_status: official beneficiary story; explicit non-closure counterexample
next_test: track the same household to completed home service restoration and later stay or move
